Mods

Scenario packs for the openASC engine. The launcher reads this catalog and installs packs for you.

BMW M3 E30 on Drift 1.0.0

The reference driving scenario: BMW M3 E30 at the Drift pit with the coupled Rust physics. Needs the stock bmw_m3_e30 car and drift track from your Assetto Corsa install.

By openASC contributors. 2 KiB. Download zip

Publish a mod

  1. Add a folder under mods/ in the repository with a mod.json (id, name, version, author, description) and your scenario files.
  2. Include no Assetto Corsa files. Scenarios refer to the user's own install through ../assettocorsa/ paths.
  3. Open a pull request. The site build zips the folder, records its SHA-256 and adds it to the catalog.

The catalog the launcher reads is mods/index.json.
